facets.description: Google CalendarService reads res?.data, which a raw fetch Response doesn't have, so token refresh fails
zoho-bigin CalendarService reads tokenInfo.data.error, which throws a TypeError on a fetch Response
zohocrm CalendarService reads zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error, which throws a TypeError on a fetch Response
Hubspot CalendarService treats the return value as a HubspotToken and reads token fields that a fetch Response doesn't have
Lark CalendarService passes the response to handleLarkError, which expects a provider-specific body ({code, msg, data})
Webex VideoApiAdapter validates the response against a provider-specific schema that the sync body doesn't match
